usedFor: ClearCRM holds leads, proposals and invoices, and Hastewire rewrites their text through “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Proposal” in ClearCRM, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: Recently created proposals feed in, and the action makes their text sound natural.

watchOut: “New Proposal” in ClearCRM is polling over a time window, so text reaches Hastewire after a scheduled check.
